alerts.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 4 at 9:47PM PST until November 5 at 8:00AM PST by NWS Hanford CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Visibility down to 1/4 mile or less.

* WHERE...A portion of central California.

* WHEN...San Joaquin Valley

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highways impacted include Interstate 5, State
Routes 33, 41, 43, 58, 152, 160, 180, and 198.
alerts.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.
